data.name: Kadin
data.gender_notes: Kadin is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘k-d-n’ which means to serve or help. In Islamic context, it is a name of honor for those who serve and help others in the way of Allah. The name Kadin carries the meaning “Servant, helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kadin usually hope their child will grow to embody servant, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To serve and help others in the way of Allah
data.etymology: Kadin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant, helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kadin total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: كادين
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العلو
in_arabic.long_meaning: كادين هو اسم علم مؤنث و مذكر في بعض الأحيان، و هو مشتق من الفعل كاد، و يعني الرفعة و العلو و الارتفاع. و قد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَكَادَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزَلِقُونَكَ بِأَبصَارِهِم' (الأنعام: 123). و يعتبر اسم كادين من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و رفيعة.

in_urdu.name: کادین
in_urdu.long_meaning: کادین ایک علم اسم ہے جو مؤنث اور مذکر دونوں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے رفعت، عزت، اور بلند مقام۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا جڑ الفعل 'كاد' ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'کوشش کرنا' یا 'محنت کرنا'۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان خوبیوں کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جو مسلمانوں کو بلند مرتبے تک پہنچنے کے لئے کوشش کرنے کی ترغیب دیتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कादिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: कादिन एक ऐसा नाम है जो संस्कृत और उर्दू में प्रयोग होता है। इसका अर्थ है 'उंचाई', 'सम्मान', और 'प्रतिष्ठा'। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है और इसे आमतौर पर बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो उच्च आदर्शों और मूल्यों के साथ जीने के लिए प्रेरित होते हैं।

in_english.name: Kadin
in_english.meaning: Name signifying elevation, honor, and prestige
in_english.long_meaning: Kadin is a unisex name derived from Arabic roots, specifically from the verb 'kād' which means 'to strive' or 'to elevate'. It signifies elevation, honor, and prestige. In Islamic tradition, the name reflects the pursuit of high moral and spiritual standards. Historically, it has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing aspirational qualities and noble characteristics.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kadin" in its cultural context often signifies a position of power and authority, such as a leader or a wife of a powerful Ottoman sultan, who held immense influence over palace affairs due to her role in managing harem. The term "kadin" even became synonymous with a noblewoman or a high-ranking female official.
data.spiritual_significance: In the religious realm, the name "Kadin" carries a deeper spiritual significance. It is a name reminiscent of the Islamic principle of serving and helping others, especially those in need. The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, taught us that serving and helping other people is pleasing to God, and is an act of self-purification. So, "Kadin," being a reminder of these teachings, is a name that encourages those who bear it to strive to be of service to the community and to live their lives with compassion and kindness. Additionally, it connects them to the historical figures of noblewomen from the Islamic Golden Age who used their power and influence for the betterment of their families and communities.
